title: E-commerce product photography: 10 foolproof tips for creating a product photo that sells!
metaTitle: E-commerce product photo: 10 tips for an effective photo!
description: 10 foolproof e-commerce product photography tips for creating the best-selling e-commerce product photo and boosting your online sales!
author: PackshotCreator
content:
Are you looking to increase sales on your site? The quality of your visuals can play a decisive role. A well-thought-out product photo does not just present an item: it makes it desirable, clear and engaging.

Here are 10 proven tips to improve your e-commerce visuals, regardless of your sector or your level of experience in photography.

1. Respect the main principles of packshot photography in your e-commerce product photos

‍

‍

For any e-commerce product photo, whether in the furniture sector or any other, it is essential to follow the best practices of packshot photography. Here are some of the main principles:

  • Represent the product faithfully, without unnecessary embellishment
  • Avoid deceptive retouching: a customer disappointed by the real thing is not a loyal customer
  • Use a neutral white background to focus attention on the product
  • Master the lighting with a neutral color temperature to guarantee faithful reproduction

If you want to know more, we encourage you to read our complete guide to packshot photography, a series of articles we have written for beginners and more experienced photographers alike. These articles cover all the technical aspects that are essential for creating quality product photos. You will also find practical tips to improve your shots and boost your sales.

2. Minimum 2 or 3 images per product

Online shoppers need clear and accurate information about the products they want to buy. To meet this need, it is recommended to have at least two or three images per product. By providing multiple photos, you also show that you have total confidence in your product. This proves to your customers that you are transparent and have nothing to hide.

This transparency reassures buyers, who feel more confident when they have access to more information. In short: the more product photos you have, the more likely you are to win your customers' trust!

3. Remember to show your product from multiple perspectives

‍

‍

Since your customers can't touch or test products online, it's essential to show your product from different angles, so that customers can get a clear idea of it. This includes the technical aspects of the product, but also its design, finishes and specific details. A 360-degree animation can also bring real added value to your product page!

4. Zoom in on the details in your e-commerce product photos

‍

‍

Some products, especially those with intricate details, require more work to give consumers a complete view. So don't hesitate to take close-up shots of certain details, for example to show the fabric of a garment or the delicate engravings on a pendant more closely. The more details you can show, the better.

Zooming in on these details also allows customers to better understand the quality of your product. For example, showing the stitching of a garment lets customers see that the product is well made and durable. This can justify a higher price and convince customers that it's worth it.

5. Incorporate one or more lifestyle photos

‍

‍

Customers often need to see the product in action and understand how it can improve their lives before making a purchase. That's where lifestyle photography comes in. This type of photo highlights the product in a very specific environment, to bring it to life and show it in a situation that could be real.

With lifestyle photography, your customers can picture what their lives will be like once they have bought the product. This helps them envision the product and see it as already part of their everyday lives. Showing your product in a real-life context also allows you to highlight its features and benefits. It's an opportunity to highlight the issues the product solves and convince customers to buy it.

6. Show how the product works or installs

As an extension of lifestyle photographs, another idea to incorporate into your e-commerce product photos is to show how the product is installed if this is not intuitive, or how the product works afterwards. It is entirely possible to create a tutorial in the form of a diagram or an image montage that you can integrate directly into your product page.

By showing how your product works or is installed, you will offer your customers an optimal shopping experience, reassure them and increase your chances of making a sale.

7. Inform about the dimensions of your product

On the internet, our perception can easily be misleading: we may imagine a product to be bigger or smaller than it really is, for example, even though the seller never intended to mislead. It is simply difficult to picture the actual dimensions of a product that you only see in pictures.

This is why it is essential to give clear information about the size of a product. You can do this in several ways:

  • in a lifestyle photograph, by placing it next to a model or an everyday object,
  • with a diagram showing its exact dimensions,
  • using a size chart if you offer multiple options.

Giving your customers this kind of clear information will also spare you many returns and complaints.

8. Optimize your e-commerce product photos for the web

‍

‍

Have you ever visited an e-commerce site and waited forever for product images to load? This is not only annoying for potential customers, it can also hurt your business.

Yet this problem can easily be solved: it is often enough to optimize and compress the product photos on your e-commerce site. By reducing the size of these files, you not only improve your site's loading speed, but you can also save storage space with your web host. This image optimization should not be taken lightly: it can considerably improve the user experience and therefore increase your conversion rate.

The JPEG format is the most commonly used image format on the web because it offers good image quality while being easy to compress. You can also optimize your e-commerce product photos directly in photo editing software like Photoshop, or use free online tools such as TinyPNG.

Having images with the right dimensions is also important for optimizing your website. An image that is too large will take longer to load than an image of the right size. Check the dimensions of your images before uploading them to make sure they suit your website.

9. Use them to boost your natural referencing (SEO)

Having product photos that sell is one thing, but having an e-commerce site that attracts many visitors from search engines is even better!

And the e-commerce product photo you are looking to optimize can also help you bring more customers to your site, thanks to organic search, or SEO (Search Engine Optimization). In fact, your images can also have a significant impact on the SEO of your site. Here's how to use your product photos to boost your SEO:

  • Fill in the image alt text by describing what the image shows and including relevant keywords. Google uses these descriptions to understand the content and context of the image.
  • Rename your images descriptively: this will also make it easier for search engines to index them.
  • Upload a sitemap of your images so that search engines can find them easily, which improves your chances of ranking (many SEO plugins on Wordpress, such as YoastSEO or Rank Math SEO, let you do this easily).
  • Optimize the size of your images, as mentioned in the previous point (the loading speed of your pages is a crucial factor for Google!).

10. Choose quality equipment

‍

‍

Last but not least: the quality of your product photos is absolutely essential. Indeed, the first thing online shoppers notice is the quality of your visuals. If your photos are not of professional quality, you risk losing sales. It is therefore imperative to use quality equipment to take your photos.

At the very least, you need a good camera and quality lighting with a neutral white background. However, if you are looking for the best in packshot photography, we recommend investing in an automated photo studio. This type of studio guarantees you an extremely high standard of quality, all with astonishing ease. With an automated photo studio, you can produce professional-quality e-commerce product photos in just a few minutes. This equipment is designed to make taking photos easy, fast and accessible to everyone.

Even if you don't have any particular photography skills, you can create flawless product photos. With an automated photo studio, you can easily adjust lighting, focus and color settings. In addition, the built-in editing software allows you to correct any small imperfections that may remain, while providing you with images that are optimized and ready to publish on your e-commerce site. All that's left is to put these 10 tips into practice to boost your online sales.

Remember that the quality of your photos is essential to make online visitors want to buy your products, so don't hesitate to consult our more in-depth guide to packshot photography or to contact us if you want to go further!
